issue_payload.body:
## Description
- New config and FF for External store
- Support SxS Internal and External store with IBlobClient which also initializes the externalStore after the app initialization to support post configuration
- Handle exceptions from external store differently than internal store

Next iteration will add a new run when the FF is on for EnE tests

## Description

- Added two new properties patientSystemId and isIssuerIdUsed that will be configured during provisioning
- Patient system id will be added while creating the patient resource in FHIR based on the above properties. Issuer of Patient Id (0010,0021) will be configured as the Patient system Id, while creating FHIR resource if the above boolean is set to true. And if not, the value would be set to patientSystemId property configured during provisioning. 

## Related issues
Addresses [Feature 93604](https://microsofthealth.visualstudio.com/Health/_workitems/edit/93604).

## Testing
Provision a new dicom cast instance and run the e2e tests to make sure the patient system id is configured correctly.
